facts: band tags alone are not signals
outside closes are initially continuation rather than reversal signals
20-period middle band and 2 standard deviations are defaults
%b and BandWidth are intended for system construction
independent confirmation such as volume or momentum is appropriate
Ice Breaker is a mean-reversion approach for severely overbought or oversold conditions
the public page does not disclose the complete proprietary entry rule
official BBS combines Bollinger concepts with MFI and volatility information
bands are a framework rather than standalone buy or sell signals

entry_sequence: outside-band close arms setup but does not enter
wait for close back inside the band
only trade in causal RANGE_MIXED or COMPRESSION regime
